# TokenBar

A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks AI coding-provider usage windows, credits, costs, and resets across 70 providers — Codex, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, LiteLLM, and more.

Canonical documentation:
